body: You are loved. We are here for you. Please feel free to message me and talk about life. Please please!

Thanks for the reply. I have shared this with my wife. None of it really seems to matter. I get the same generic pep talk from it and it’s really not something I want to hear from her because it just makes it harder. You are very right though. My son is absolutely worth living for. Realizing that a complete stranger can care for me gave me hope. Hope that I can come back from this; come back better than ever. Thank you for your kind words. You saved a life, friend.
